baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ assigns the seizure to the addressee's Lord, while لَشَدِيدٌ emphatically predicates severity of it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Forceful taking is joined to lordly ownership and hard capacity: the verse presents a concentrated, attributable seizure backed by authority, not diffuse danger or uncontrolled anger.

activation_trace.role: Forceful taking under overpowering pressure supplies the concrete action at the center of the model.
Lordship, possession, and command assign the action to an agent with jurisdiction rather than to anonymous violence.
Hardness, strength, and capacity make the seizure resistant to opposition and fully consequential.

changed_reading.before: A general assurance that God is powerful against wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: An emphatic warning of an owned and jurisdictional act of forceful taking whose hardness makes resistance ineffective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَطْشَ supplies grasping, and the predicate شَدِيدٌ can activate fastening as well as sheer intensity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The seizure behaves as a grip that closes and remains: taking initiates capture, fastening removes looseness, and the Lord relation lends duration. Severity is therefore tenacity, not only impact.

activation_trace.role: The seizing hand supplies initial capture rather than a merely descriptive threat.
Fastening a bond turns severity into closure: what is seized is tied against release.
Staying and lasting add persistence to the possessive relation, so the grip is not momentary.

changed_reading.before: Severity describes how hard a blow lands.
changed_reading.after: Severity also describes how completely the seizure binds and how little room it leaves for escape or reversal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The action is explicitly the بَطْش of رَبِّكَ, allowing the governing and nurturing range of رب to qualify the force without weakening شديد.
baseline_models.mechanism: If lordship includes tending, repairing, and carrying a process to completion, a severe seizure can function as removal of a destructive agency from an administered order. The act stays genuinely violent in force while acquiring a potentially corrective purpose.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering seizure preserves the model's hard intervention rather than reducing it to moral guidance.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply an administrative end toward which the intervention may be directed.
Strength and hardness prevent the corrective reading from domesticating the stated severity.

changed_reading.before: The Lord relation identifies only who delivers punishment.
changed_reading.after: The Lord relation may also identify why severe seizure occurs: forceful interruption can restore an order under care.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elevation and fortified towers create an image of protected height. Against that scale, the focus seizure becomes reach that crosses vertical distance and defeats the assumption that prominence or enclosure can make power inaccessible.

activation_trace.role: Forceful taking is recast as a reach capable of arriving at an apparently protected target.
Height and elevation supply the vertical distance that the seizure must traverse.
Fortified towers supply the image of defended prominence whose security the seizure negates.

structural_cues: The opening oath places sky and towers before the focus assertion, establishing an elevated spatial scale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies elevation and fortified enclosure; I infer that divine seizure can breach their protective value. A live alternative is that the towers are celestial markers and set scale without implying defense.

changed_reading.before: The seizure is severe at the point where it lands.
changed_reading.after: The seizure is also impossible to outclimb or outfortify; elevated enclosure does not place a target beyond its reach.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded period joined to an appointment turns the severe seizure from an impulsive outburst into force held to a due time. Delay can therefore indicate scheduling rather than weakness.

activation_trace.role: The concrete seizure supplies the event whose timing is being re-read.
A delimited span of time gives the intervention a temporal container.
An appointment fixed to time or place supplies due arrival rather than spontaneous discharge.
The threatening side of promise gives the appointment adverse force for its target.

structural_cues: The promised day is sworn before the narrative and before the focus claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded time and an appointed threat; I infer appointment -> delayed but certain seizure. Alternatively, the promised day may frame the whole discourse without specifying when this particular seizure occurs.

changed_reading.before: If seizure has not yet occurred, its force may appear absent.
changed_reading.after: Its severity includes kept appointment: restraint before the due time is compatible with certainty at arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated witnessing places the persecutors' deed inside a field of presence, disclosure, and knowledge. The focus seizure consequently reads as an accountable response to an established act, not as opaque force.

activation_trace.role: Lordly authority supplies the competent agent who can act on what is witnessed.
Presence together with seeing supplies the basic evidentiary scene of witness and witnessed.
Disclosure grounded in knowledge converts observation into a basis for accountable action.

structural_cues: The witness root recurs as paired witness/witnessed, as the perpetrators' self-witnessing, and as divine witnessing before 85:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reiterated presence and knowledgeable disclosure; I infer accumulated witness -> warranted intervention. The alternative is that witnessing guarantees knowledge but does not itself supply a judicial sequence.

changed_reading.before: A superior power suddenly seizes offenders.
changed_reading.after: A fully witnessed deed ripens into a severe seizure whose force is evidentiary and accountable rather than arbitrary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context assembles an apparatus: killing, a long excavated channel, supplied fuel, fixed watchers, and witnessed action. The focus then reverses agency: those who built a controlled mechanism for taking others are themselves exposed to a stronger taking.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering seizure supplies the counter-action that reverses who controls force.
Taking life establishes the terminal violence produced by the persecutors' apparatus.
The long sunken cut supplies engineered containment and a controlled site of harm.
Fuel supplies maintained material input, showing that the violence is provisioned rather than accidental.
Sitting in watch supplies fixed surveillance and deliberate control over the scene.
Presence with direct seeing makes the perpetrators conscious participants in what they administer.

structural_cues: The narrative moves from built trench to fuel to seated observation, then later names the Lord's seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a deliberately maintained coercive system; I infer subject-object reversal when the later seizure is assigned to the Lord. The live alternative is a broader warning whose target exceeds the scene's immediate controllers.

changed_reading.before: Divine punishment follows human wrongdoing in a generic sequence.
changed_reading.after: The severe seizure is a reversal of the persecutors' own controlled taking: the operators of enclosure, fuel, and spectacle lose control of agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Invincible dominance, praiseworthiness, sovereignty, and total scope expand رَبِّكَ into rightful jurisdiction over the entire venue. The seizure becomes repossession of an order that local persecutors temporarily treated as theirs.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and ownership provide the focus verse's direct jurisdictional anchor.
Dominance and overcoming remove the possibility of a rival sovereign successfully resisting repossession.
Praise as the opposite of blame supplies a moral distinction between rightful force and the persecutors' violence.
Sovereignty and rule enlarge the Lord relation from personal protection to cosmic jurisdiction.
Completeness and encompassing totality deny any residual domain outside that jurisdiction.

structural_cues: The persecutors resent belief in the very One whose dominion is then expressed as encompassing heavens, earth, and every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unrivaled dominion and moral praise; I infer seizure -> repossession by the rightful governor. Alternatively, these titles may amplify capacity without specifying a restorative legal function.

changed_reading.before: Two superior forces confront one another, with the stronger eventually winning.
changed_reading.after: The persecutors never own the field they control; the Lord's severe seizure reasserts an already comprehensive jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Assay-like trial exposes what agents do, an elicited return remains conceptually open, and painful punishment follows non-return. The binding seizure can thus be a terminal closure after refused revision rather than an indiscriminate first move.

activation_trace.role: Fastening supplies the final closure reached when the prior opening is not taken.
Assaying metal or a person supplies an exposing process in which conduct becomes manifest.
Calling another toward repentance supplies a solicited possibility of return before closure.
Pain and punishment supply the adverse consequence attached to persistent refusal.

structural_cues: The explicit sequence marks persecution, then non-repentance, then punishment before the focus assertion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, an elicited return, and punishment; I infer an open-return phase -> severe closure after refusal. A live alternative is that non-repentance merely classifies the perpetrators and does not describe stages in the seizure.

changed_reading.before: The severe grip closes immediately and without an antecedent opening.
changed_reading.after: The severe grip can be the closure of a path that remained open to return but was persistently refused.

context_deltas.mechanism: The protected garden, continuing flow, and safe attainment stand beside punishment. This opposition makes the seizure selective: it breaks one arrangement while preserving and carrying another, functioning as a boundary rather than undifferentiated devastation.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion permit force to preserve one process while ending another.
A garden hidden and covered by growth supplies a protected destination opposite exposed burning.
Continuing provision and gift supply an outcome of sustained life rather than mere survival.
Attainment of good and escape supplies the positive side of the separating outcome.

structural_cues: The reward verse immediately contrasts the two punishments of 85:10 before 85:12 names the severe seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed outcomes of punishment and protected flourishing; I infer the seizure draws the operative boundary between them. Alternatively, the contrast may describe final outcomes without making seizure itself the separating mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Severe seizure is a single destructive magnitude applied to its object.
changed_reading.after: Severe seizure can be discriminating force: it ends a persecuting order while securing a different continuity for those harmed by it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beginning joined to return makes the focus seizure a reusable capacity rather than a one-off expenditure. The agent can originate an intervention and bring it back, so historical delay does not exhaust the threat.

activation_trace.role: Capacity and strength supply the durable power that can support more than one intervention.
Beginning explicitly paired with return supplies a two-phase cycle rather than an isolated start.
Coming back after departure supplies repeatability and renewed application.

structural_cues: The begin-and-return pair follows the focus assertion immediately and shares its emphatic subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origination and return; I infer repeatable agency -> seizure not depleted by one occurrence. The alternative is that the pair concerns creation or resurrection and only indirectly bears on punitive action.

changed_reading.before: The verse recalls one exceptional act of overwhelming force.
changed_reading.after: The verse names a standing capacity that can initiate, recur, and restore consequences across more than one occasion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same subject who seizes severely is then characterized by protective covering and love. This does not soften the seizure; it constrains possible purpose, allowing hard removal of harm to coexist with shelter, restored relation, and care.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering seizure keeps the intervention severe and materially consequential.
Repair and nurture provide a focus-internal bridge from hard intervention to restorative governance.
Covering wrongdoing while protecting its bearer from the effect supplies a reparative possibility after rupture.
Active affection prevents severe force from exhausting the agent's relation to creatures.

structural_cues: The forgiving and loving predicates follow directly after the seizure and begin/return assertions with an unchanged subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severe seizure, nurturing lordship, protective covering, and love; I infer shared agency -> force may remove what blocks repair. A live alternative is that severity and love address distinct recipients with no single corrective mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Severity and mercy are separate divine modes that must be read in different moments.
changed_reading.after: Severe seizure and restorative love coexist in one governing profile: force can protect, clear, and reopen relation without ceasing to be severe.

context_deltas.mechanism: A stable seat of rule, unrestricted acting, and will convert severity from emotional intensity into low-friction enactment. The seizure is severe because intention, authority, and execution do not separate under resistance.

activation_trace.role: Strength and capacity supply the focus predicate's operational force.
The support and stability of rule supply an institutional base that does not collapse under action.
Bringing an act into occurrence supplies execution rather than merely possessed power.
Will and intention supply the directive immediately realized in action.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from throne-bearing rule to an intensive agent noun for doing and then to what is willed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable rule, repeated doing, and will; I infer will -> execution without an obstructing gap. Alternatively, the titles assert general freedom of action without defining what makes the focus seizure severe.

changed_reading.before: Severity is mainly the amount of force applied.
changed_reading.after: Severity also lies in the unbroken conversion of sovereign intention into accomplished seizure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering truth and sustained denial create an attempted epistemic shelter; the later image of a rear side enclosed from every direction defeats it spatially. The binding grip now closes not only on a body but around every imagined outside or escape route.

activation_trace.role: Fastening a bond supplies closure within the focus predicate.
Hiding truth supplies the attempted cover under which the deniers remain.
Contradiction of truth supplies the maintained stance that mistakes denial for an exit.
The rear, front, or other side supplies a spatially unstable outside that cannot be secured as an escape direction.
Overmastering enclosure supplies the completed perimeter and its destructive consequence.

structural_cues: The adversative turn leaves the deniers inside denial, then places divine enclosure behind and around them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, contradiction, an indeterminate rear side, and encompassing dominance; I infer false shelter -> no exterior to the seizure. The alternative is that enclosure denotes exhaustive knowledge rather than punitive reach.

changed_reading.before: The severe grip catches a target when it reaches that target.
changed_reading.after: The severe grip is already circumferential: concealment and retreat merely disclose that every side lies within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathered recitation, a writing surface, and guarded preservation echo the fastening range of شديد. The Lord's seizure can be heard not only as future physical impact but as an already binding pronouncement held intact against denial.

activation_trace.role: Fastening and securing a bond supply the focus-side image of a statement that holds.
Gathering and collection supply a discourse whose parts are assembled into a coherent charge.
A broad surface for writing supplies fixation and public legibility rather than evanescent speech.
Guarding and attentive preservation prevent the pronouncement from being erased or escaped through denial.

structural_cues: The closing adversative reclassifies the denied discourse as a gathered recitation in a guarded writing medium.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathered discourse, inscription, and preservation; I infer semantic fixation -> a verdict-like grip already operating through the utterance. Alternatively, the closing preservation concerns revelation alone and does not redescribe seizure.

changed_reading.before: The verse predicts only an external event that will later seize bodies.
changed_reading.after: The verse also performs a binding act now: its preserved pronouncement holds the deniers within an inerasable account before physical outcome arrives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر ب و mapping for رَبِّ and the day-height branch of شديد rather than their ordinary local senses. It remains anchored to focus words 3-4 and coheres with بَطْش as force reaching culmination; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary kinetic image, never as a lexical replacement for Lord or severe.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ can activate swelling/rising followed by arrival at full height.

activation_trace.role: Forceful seizure supplies the kinetic event whose intensity can mount.
The split root's increase and rising image supplies swelling ascent within the focus sequence.
Daylight reaching height supplies culmination or crest rather than static quantity.

changed_reading.before: Severity is a fixed property already present at one level.
changed_reading.after: The seizure can be imagined as pressure that swells, rises, and reaches a crest at the moment of taking.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation is surprising because the hidden-fire branch is attached to the later word for a rear side, not directly to بَطْش. It remains anchored through the focus's sudden seizing action and the packet's explicit ignition sequence; render it as a material analogy for latent capacity, not as a claim that 85:20 lexically means fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The forceful event in بَطْشَ can be modeled as stored capacity that becomes manifest abruptly.

activation_trace.role: The sudden forceful taking supplies the discharge event.
Ignition supplies the transition from stored material to active flame.
Fire latent in a striker supplies hidden potency that appears only when struck forth.

changed_reading.before: Divine dominance must remain visibly active at every moment to be real.
changed_reading.after: Severe seizure may remain latent like fire in a striker, then disclose stored force in a sudden irreversible act.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because the victory inventory explicitly permits death or destruction as a paradoxical attainment, reversing ordinary outcome metrics. It remains anchored to the focus seizure through the context's killing/victory opposition; downstream prose should qualify it as a perspective reversal and must not imply that suffering is intrinsically desirable or that every death is victory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بَطْشَ names overpowering force, but the context can reverse which party that force finally defeats.

activation_trace.role: Forceful taking supplies the apparent metric by which persecutors seem victorious and the later metric that overturns them.
Death supplies the apparent terminal defeat whose meaning is contested.
The branch in which death or destruction can count as attainment supplies the paradoxical reversal of visible loss.
Attainment of good and escape keeps the paradox directed toward genuine deliverance rather than mere destruction.

changed_reading.before: The party able to seize and kill controls the final meaning of the event.
changed_reading.after: Human killing can fail to secure victory; the Lord's severe seizure reverses the outcome scale on which apparent defeat was measured.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from generic punitive power to a reversal of an engineered system of enclosure, fuel, surveillance, and killing.
Repeated witness and the promised time made the seizure evidentiary and appointed rather than impulsive.
Fastening plus later enclosure changed a hard blow into a circumferential grip with no secure outside.
Nurturing lordship, protective forgiveness, and love allowed severe intervention and restorative purpose to coexist without dissolving either.
The preserved-recitation ending activated an exploratory juridical reading in which the utterance already binds before the external event.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's three roots generated more than a magnitude claim: seizing, governing, fastening, and capacity formed a compact mechanism that context could rotate through spatial breach, temporal appointment, evidentiary response, selective protection, recurrence, and preserved pronouncement. Split-root and branch-distant images were retained where they changed the reading and were explicitly contained rather than silently normalized away.
remaining_uncertainties: The promised day may frame the discourse without directly timing the focus seizure.
The corrective reading depends on treating nurture, forgiveness, and love as constraints on the purpose of the same severe agency rather than as predicates for separate recipients.
The preserved-pronouncement model is mechanistically coherent but analogical rather than syntactically explicit.
The cresting-force and latent-spark outliers depend on non-dominant or branch-distant inventory activations and should remain secondary.
